answer: Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the summit queue while genuine members promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1092 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the canyon. The meadow index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Honest users pay that once, farms 38 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
